note: Each issue comes from a fixed rule over public data (the rules are listed at the top of src/farmdrought/issues.py). Cut-offs for reservoirs and rain are our own choices. Sealing issues assume unlined canals. An issue is a prompt to check, not a finding.

issues.title: Freeze Warning: Sierra, New Mexico, Doña Ana, New Mexico
issues.detail: Freeze Warning issued November 21 at 10:17AM MST until November 22 at 9:00AM MST by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM Weather service severity: Severe.
issues.who: County officials and anyone working outdoors

issues.title: Delta Lake Irrigation District: decide on sealing 62.6 km of canal
issues.detail: The 6-month outlook for its counties is 0.32, over the 0.25 warning line. At a $100,000 budget for all districts, the plan puts $16,433 here. The plan assumes unlined canals, so check lining on the ground first.
issues.source: Our 6-month outlook, the USGS canal map, the USDA soil survey

issues.title: No real rain forecast this week for 3 of 7 Warning counties
issues.detail: Under 0.1 inch in the next 7 days at the county center: Saguache, Colorado, Dimmit, Texas, Webb, Texas. A week's forecast says nothing about the season. It only means no relief is on the way right now.
issues.who: Everyone planning water for the next week

issues.title: Live river flow in Big Bend
issues.detail: Rio Grande near Castolon: 45 cubic feet per second; Rio Grande at Rio Grande Village: 185 cubic feet per second. Both gauges are upstream of the canal districts. Flow near the districts is measured by the boundary commission, which has no open data service.
